# Bitesize Pediatric Dentistry

> > Expert pediatric dental and orthodontic care for children in Brooklyn with a focus on gentle, kid-friendly treatment and early interceptive care.

Bitesize Pediatric Dentistry operates three convenient locations across Brooklyn (Williamsburg, Park Slope, and DUMBO) and specializes in comprehensive preventive and restorative dental services, orthodontics, and sedation dentistry for children. The practice uses educational characters and flexible financing options to make dental care accessible and engaging for young patients.

## Pediatric Dental Services

- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://wearebitesize.com/pediatric-dentistry): Main pediatric dentistry service page highlighting gentle, expert care in Brooklyn.
- [Pediatric Dental Services Overview](https://wearebitesize.com/pediatric-dental-services): Overview of comprehensive preventive and restorative pediatric dental services at Bitesize.
- [Pediatric Dental Cleanings & Exams](https://wearebitesize.com/pediatric-dental-services/pediatric-dental-cleanings-exams): Details on pediatric dental cleanings and exams for children in Williamsburg, Brooklyn.
- [Dental Sealants](https://wearebitesize.com/pediatric-dental-services/sealants): Information on dental sealants as effective tooth decay prevention for children.
- [Silver Diamine Fluoride Treatment](https://wearebitesize.com/pediatric-dental-services/silver-diamine-fluoride): Guide to Silver Diamine Fluoride cavity prevention and treatment for pediatric patients.
- [Pediatric Sedation Dentistry](https://wearebitesize.com/pediatric-dental-services/pediatric-sedation-dentistry): Information on nitrous oxide sedation options for anxious children at Bitesize.
- [Dental Appliances & Maintainers](https://wearebitesize.com/pediatric-dental-services/dental-appliances-maintainers): Details on dental appliances and space maintainers for correcting bites and habits.
